scope: Generic actual x86 KVM/module transport controls for kernel-owned native submissions, source context, authorized map references, registered-service capabilities and proof provenance.

design.submission: NATIVE_LAB_TRUSTED_SUBMIT_RESOURCES ioctl0x77 uses struct native_lab_trusted_submission: existing64-byte request, u32 map_count, zero u32 reserved, u64 map_fds_user; complete extent80bytes.
design.compatibility: Original64-byte SUBMIT, NEXT, CONTEXT, MAP and result layouts retain their ABI. The final queued disconnect case exercises successful legacy SUBMIT after the resource submission.
design.authorization: Kernel copies the signed32 FD vector, resolves each FD with bpf_map_get in the submitting task, rejects duplicate actual objects and bounds the vector by existing verifier MAX_USED_MAPS64.
design.snapshot: Resolved actual object references become immutable capsule fields before queue publication. Source used_maps and these native resource references supply the registered-service MAP query; actual inner-template traversal and kernel shape fields are retained.
design.lifetime: The capsule owns references through request, sealed-chunk and bound-program krefs. Partial FD/copyback failures and request completion release them through the common capsule destructor.
design.verification: The registered service generates B from kernel-owned P. Existing actual verifier checks and native relocation/source/context/generation/ABI binding remain in their paths; the service queries declared resource IDs through the capsule.
design.application_integration: C owns native-symbol metadata/live deduplicated FD submission and worker query integration; C/A adopt a coherent kernel/loader/service image before whole-application replay.

validation.platform: cached x86 kernel; vng KVM2vCPU/2GiB on8-11; incremental module/test build
validation.previous_outcomes_retained: 16 expected refusals,2 positive case outcomes and1 suite summary;15 additional named cases cover14 refusals and1 positive resource case.

positive_records: immutable native ELF/entry/metadata survive producer mutation
native-only map capability survives descriptor mutation and close
kernel source/load attributes and actual outer/inner map shapes
registered trusted transport, immutable P, application proof refusal and fail-closed disconnect

lifetime_api_results.lookup: after completed request and submitting-file close

validation.initial_diagnostic: The initial test expected syscall-style -1 from libbpf map-ID lookup. The actual lookup API returns negative errno; the final helper checks exact -ENOENT plus errno and records both. Kernel resource implementation stayed unchanged across these test-source epochs.
validation.arm_interfaces: Common header is included after bpf_verifier.h by both ISA modules; the cached ARM kernel exports bpf_map_get/bpf_map_put. Actual runtime collection here is x86; A supplies coherent ARM module/loader adoption.
